name: Higashimatsuyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashimatsuyama city emblem in green: a six-pointed star bearing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Higashimatsuyama, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 September 1954.

features.role: Higashimatsuyama city emblem — a six-pointed star bearing a stylised character
